class.name: InterDVDProject
class.brief_description: Authoring graph for a VIDEO_TS / AUDIO_TS disc.
class.description: Compiled disc graph consumed by the IFO writer. Prefer an [InterDVDDisc] scene tree; export calls [method InterDVDDisc.build_project]. A saved [code].tres[/code] still works when [code]blazium/inter_dvd/project[/code] is set. Encode fields on this resource are used during bake/mux.

method.name: add_title_from_video
method.description: Creates a title PGC with one cell whose [member InterDVDCell.source_path] is [param path], appends it to [member titles], and returns the title.

method.name: add_titles_from_videos
method.description: Calls [method add_title_from_video] for each non-empty path and returns the titles that were added.

method.name: add_chapter_from_video
method.description: Appends a video cell (chapter) to title [param title_n] (1-based). [code]0[/code] means the last title. If there are no titles yet, creates title 1 from [param path].

method.name: add_title_from_scene
method.description: Creates a title PGC with one cell that bakes [param scene] for [param duration_sec] seconds and appends it to [member titles].

method.name: add_title_menu
method.description: Appends a VMGM [constant InterDVDMenu.MENU_TITLE] menu (still time 0) with a Play button that jumps to title 1.

method.name: add_menu_title
method.description: Appends a VLC-safe title PGC named [code]Menu[/code] with a Jump Title button to title 1. Prefer this over JumpSS/CallSS from the title domain when returning to a menu.

method.name: ensure_first_play
method.description: Creates or updates [member first_play] so First Play JumpTT goes to [param title_n] (the main title). Returns the First Play PGC.

method.name: language_be16
method.description: Packs an ISO 639-1 code into the 16-bit IFO language field ([code]en[/code] is [code]0x656E[/code]).

method.name: sanitize_volume_id
method.description: Uppercase ISO9660 volume label: [code]A-Z0-9_[/code], max 32 characters. Empty input becomes [code]BLAZIUM_DVD[/code].

method.name: reset_encode_defaults
method.description: Resets encode and region fields to engine defaults (region 1, AC3 192 kbps stereo, GOP 15, title-safe 432, warmup 2).
